title: DML Concept Diagram
text:
Presenter Flow
One effective speaking sequence is:

Start in the center and frame DML as one connected infrastructure.
Advance once for Support and explain how researchers are helped across the project lifecycle.
Advance again for Integration to show how data and methods connect across groups.
Advance a third time for Transfer to close with practice, interfaces, and stakeholder-facing outputs.

The diagram works best as a navigation slide, not as a dense information slide.

title: Data and Modelling Infrastructure for Living Labs
text:
IAT Service Working Group


Discuss your project with us
Welcome to the website of the Data and Modelling Infrastructure for Living Labs (DML) Working Group. We are a service working group within the Innovation Center for Agricultural System Transformation (IAT) as part of the Liebniz Center for Agricultural Landscape Research (ZALF). Our mission is to support researchers and partners within the IAT with all things related to data and modelling. We have represented the different ways that we do this in the graphic below:
